annotations.title: Single-audit finding repeat rate (findings marked as repeats of a prior-year finding) for small local governments, by federal program and compliance requirement, from the Federal Audit Clearinghouse (signed)

description: Single-audit finding repeat rate for small US local governments (cities, counties, towns, special districts, school districts), pooled from the Federal Audit Clearinghouse: of the findings auditors reported on federal programs, how many were marked as repeats of a prior-year finding. Filter by federal program (assistance listing number, e.g. '10.555', or a 2-digit agency prefix, e.g. '14'), compliance requirement letter (A to P, e.g. 'L' reporting, 'I' procurement), state, audit year (2022, 2023, 2024) and size (small = under $5,000,000 federal awards expended, the default; or all_local). Get back findings, repeat findings, the repeat rate with a 95% interval, audits with findings, the baseline rate for the same pool without your program and letter filter, a breakdown, sources with the date each year was read, and a signed record. Free. No model, nothing stored. Not audit, legal or grant advice: it counts what auditors flagged; it does not judge any government or predict a finding.

aln.description: Assistance listing number (CFDA), e.g. '10.555', '14.218', '21.027', or just the 2-digit agency prefix, e.g. '93'.

audit_year.description: One audit year as the Clearinghouse records it. Leave out for all years read.

size.description: small (default): local governments that spent under $5,000,000 in federal awards that year. all_local: every local government.

state.description: US state or territory, 2-letter code, e.g. 'TX'.

type.description: Compliance requirement letter: A Activities allowed or unallowed; B Allowable costs/cost principles; C Cash management; E Eligibility; F Equipment and real property management; G Matching, level of effort, earmarking; H Period of performance; I Procurement and suspension and debarment; J Program income; L Reporting; M Subrecipient monitoring; N Special tests and provisions; P Other.
